# Spectrum

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Spectrum`](gmeow-Spectrum.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Spectrum>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A first-class information object representing a partial list or recording-region spectrum. Spectra are the source material from which pitch collections may be derived by a solver (fnSpectrumToPitchCollection) — the canonical content of spectralism ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).
